description: Changes the drawing. Takes a list of operations and applies them in order as a single edit. The list is all-or-nothing: if any operation is invalid nothing changes and the error is returned so you can correct it. Returns the ids of the nodes that were added, lists any property you wrote that the format does not know (usually a misspelling), which was kept but has no effect, and under "problems" what the edit left wrong: a room that does not close and the wall end that may be why, walls drawn over each other, a door outside its wall.

oneOf.description: Adds a node. Pages and components take no parent; every other node needs a page, component or group as parent.

node.description: A node as in the document schema. "id" and "order" may be omitted.

oneOf.description: Changes properties of a node. Set "parent" or "order" to move it. "id" and "type" cannot change.

patch.description: Shallow merge patch: each key replaces that property, and a null value removes it.

oneOf.description: Removes a node and everything inside it. Removing a component also removes its instances, and removing an object the links that join it to others.

patch.description: Shallow merge patch: each key replaces that property, and a null value removes it.

oneOf.description: Removes a layer. Its nodes move to the first remaining layer.
Adds a shared colour. Use it by setting a colour property (style.stroke, style.fill, a layer color) to "var(--<id>)".

Adds a dimension style: a name and whichever properties of a dimension it defines, under the same names (style, startMarker, size, unit…). Dimensions take it with "dimensionStyle": "<id>".
Changes a dimension style; every dimension in it follows, except where it has a value of its own. A null in the patch makes the style stop defining that property.

patch.description: Shallow merge patch: each key replaces that property, and a null value removes it.

oneOf.description: Removes a dimension style. Its dimensions keep how they look: what the style gave them becomes their own.
Adds a material: a name, and the fill and pattern it is drawn with. Walls and the floors of rooms take it with "material": "<id>".
Changes a material; every wall and floor made of it follows. A null in the patch removes that property.

patch.description: Shallow merge patch: each key replaces that property, and a null value removes it.

oneOf.description: Removes a material. Walls made of it are of the default material after; floors made of it keep its colour and pattern as their own. The default material cannot be removed.
Changes a shared colour; everything that refers to it changes with it.

oneOf.description: Removes a shared colour. What referred to it keeps the colour it had, as a plain colour.
Embeds a file (base64) so image nodes can show it. Assets are dropped on save once nothing uses them.

Renames the document and/or changes what it says about itself ("info": project, client, address, author), shown in title blocks, and/or how it writes its numbers and lays out its title blocks ("settings": system, decimal, titleBlock) and the grid the editor shows ("grid": spacing of its main lines in mm, and the divisions of each square). In "info" and "settings" each key replaces that entry and a null or empty value removes it.
